name: DeSoto Market Place
summary: DeSoto Market Place is a community-oriented shopping center in DeSoto, Texas, managed by the DeSoto Development Corporation. The center features flexible operating hours and available lease spaces, serving as a hub for local businesses and neighborhood shopping in the southern Dallas-Fort Worth area.
demographics: DeSoto Market Place serves a diverse, family-oriented community in the southern Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex. The primary trade area consists of middle-income households with a mix of young families and established residents seeking convenient neighborhood shopping. Visitors typically include local residents looking for essential services, small business support, and community-focused retail experiences. The center attracts shoppers who value accessibility and personalized service over big-box retail, with strong support for local entrepreneurship and small business development.
description: DeSoto Market Place is a community-focused shopping destination located at 324 East Belt Line Road in DeSoto, Texas, serving the southern Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex. Developed and managed by the DeSoto Development Corporation, this center represents the city's commitment to fostering local business growth and providing accessible retail options for residents. The center operates on a unique schedule designed to accommodate the community's needs, with extended hours Thursday through Saturday and limited Sunday hours when select stores are open. With convenient access and ample parking, DeSoto Market Place offers a welcoming environment for shoppers seeking a neighborhood retail experience. The center continues to grow with available lease spaces for new businesses, reflecting DeSoto's ongoing economic development and commitment to supporting local entrepreneurs.
